_comment: Engineering Labs IA — four system-level environments, not a catalogue of isolated transformer meshes. No new CAD this cycle. Grid Lab is live. Transformer Lab is a drill-down index over existing explorers. Factory Lab and Substation & Protection Lab are coming (no simulators here).
framing: Think in Labs and systems, not in “3D models”. Component-level transformer views already exist; they sit inside Transformer Lab rather than as ten front doors.

mental_models.system: GRID → SUBSTATION → TRANSFORMER → COMPONENT → PHYSICS → FAULT/OPERATION

labs.title: Grid Lab
labs.summary: Generation → GSU → transmission → autotransformer → substation → step-down → distribution → consumer. Census scenarios (frequency, UHV / 765 kV, synchronous areas). Later: load, OLTC, N-1, faults, country architectures. Not another transformer mesh.

labs.title: Transformer Lab
labs.summary: One drill-down through the machine: Tank → Core → Windings → Insulation → Leads → Bushings → OLTC → Cooling → Protection. Existing explorers are rooms inside this Lab — not ten separate products.

drilldown.note: Leads and cleats on the CCA
Existing condenser-bushing cutaway — not a new Bushings Lab
ODAF cooler banks on the 500 MVA unit
Fault / Buchholz path on the power unit

labs.title: Factory Lab
labs.summary: Later, commercially important: CRGO → core cutting → stacking → winding → insulation → active part → drying → tanking → vacuum filling → assembly → testing → dispatch. Clicks will link Academy, Machinery, Materials, suppliers and RFQ. No simulator in this cycle.

labs.title: Substation & Protection Lab
labs.summary: Before another component model: 400/132/33 kV AIS/GIS; click through to existing transformer / bushing / OLTC; later animate CB / CT / CVT / arrester / busbar; fault → CT → differential → trip → isolate. No simulator in this cycle.
